'''Sir''' was a title in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The title was also bestowed upon [[Knight (noble rank)/Legends|Knights]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. In the Tapani sector the female version of Sir was '''Dame'''.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] also addressed both male and female [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] or other higher-ranking soldiers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as Sir.
